obligations.name: Mapping maintenance
obligations.description: Maintain governed SKU, supplier-item, and store aliases.
obligations.triggering_condition: New supplier item, changed alias, or ambiguous mapping
obligations.uncertainty_note: Volume, time, and rate are modeled; mappings alone only prove the surface exists.
obligations.risk_rationale: Bad aliases can block several configured flows.

obligations.name: Native integration monitoring
obligations.triggering_condition: Connector batch lacks acknowledgement or mapping becomes invalid
obligations.uncertainty_note: No real vendor outage or production rate is claimed.
obligations.risk_rationale: External connector behavior can delay cross-channel evidence.

obligations.name: Automation failure handling
obligations.description: Investigate retry exhaustion, validation blocks, and rule changes.
obligations.triggering_condition: Retry exhausted or validation blocks an action
obligations.uncertainty_note: Failure paths are observed synthetically; annual handling effort is modeled.
obligations.risk_rationale: Some failures do not self-heal and need human investigation.

obligations.name: BI/report maintenance
obligations.description: Maintain categories, filters, store groups, and report definitions.
obligations.triggering_condition: Management adds a category or changes a reporting question
obligations.uncertainty_note: Definitions exist; their change rate and effort are modeled.
obligations.risk_rationale: Most definition changes are bounded configuration edits.

obligations.name: Role/access administration
obligations.description: Grant, change, review, and revoke configured access.
obligations.uncertainty_note: This models administration and does not implement authentication.

obligations.name: Subscription/platform administration
obligations.description: Review renewals, seats, plans, and fictional vendor contacts.
obligations.triggering_condition: Quarterly seat review or annual renewal activity
obligations.uncertainty_note: Administrative effort is fictional and not vendor pricing.

obligations.name: Vendor/schema changes
obligations.description: Update mapping/report rules after a fictional export contract changes.
obligations.triggering_condition: Fictional export field is renamed or status vocabulary changes
obligations.uncertainty_note: The bounded rename scenario is fictional, not a real vendor claim.
obligations.risk_rationale: Future external schema behavior is unresolved.

obligations.name: Store onboarding support preparation
obligations.description: Keep an onboarding checklist for identity, roles, groups, mappings, reports, connector, and automation inclusion.
obligations.triggering_condition: Annual readiness review before any future store is added
obligations.uncertainty_note: Preparation only; no seventh store is created or onboarded.
obligations.risk_rationale: Several existing configuration surfaces must remain aligned.

obligations.name: User support / operational questions
obligations.description: Explain report changes and receiving or transfer exceptions.
obligations.triggering_condition: Manager requests interpretation of configured output
obligations.uncertainty_note: Only bounded configuration-related questions are modeled.
obligations.risk_rationale: Questions usually require explanation rather than repair.

obligations.name: Exception-rule maintenance
obligations.description: Review thresholds, ownership, and routing rules.
obligations.triggering_condition: Policy, alert owner, or exception threshold changes
obligations.uncertainty_note: Rule existence is observed; maintenance frequency and effort are modeled.
obligations.risk_rationale: Incorrect thresholds can hide or overproduce exceptions.
